faq.intro: Clear answers about collections, garment care, tracking, payments and changing your membership.

items.answer: Drop your numbered Washd bag at your building's collection point by 9:30am on a route day. A Monday drop returns Wednesday, and a Wednesday drop returns Friday at 5:30pm.
items.question: How does the fixed collection schedule work?

items.answer: Yes. Your member dashboard updates as your bag is received, cleaned, finished and made ready for collection. You will also see the latest update time and expected return.
items.question: Can I track my laundry after collection?

items.answer: No. Every numbered bag is photographed, counted and processed as its own load. Your garments are never mixed with another household's laundry.
items.question: Are my clothes washed with another customer's laundry?

items.answer: Everyday clothes, towels and suitable bed linen can go into the zipped bag. Delicates, specialty fabrics and items with unusual care labels should be discussed with us first.
items.question: What can go into an Everyday Bag?

items.answer: Yes. Choose an à-la-carte add-on while reviewing your plan, or send us a custom-plan enquiry if you need a different recurring combination.
items.question: Can I add ironing or another bag without changing plans?

items.answer: Your bag moves to the next scheduled route day. Message Washd as soon as possible and we will confirm the next available collection for your building.
items.question: What happens if I miss my building's drop time?

items.answer: Memberships are billed monthly through secure Stripe checkout. You can manage your payment method and cancel from your account, with two weeks' notice before the next service period.
items.question: How do payments and cancellations work?

items.answer: Report the issue within 24 hours of collection. Our photographed count and bag history help us investigate quickly, and qualifying issues are handled under the Washd care guarantee.
items.question: What if an item is damaged or missing?
